name: Move quick-check consent gating behind the missing-session return
description: Root cause verified on origin/main 08d75f4: POST /assessments/quick-check asserts LLM consent before the scoped session lookup, although a missing or wrong-profile session returns 404 and cannot reach evaluateQuickCheckAnswer/routeAndCall. Withdrawn consent therefore masks that deterministic not-found outcome.
acceptanceCriteria:
Definition of done (source baseline: origin/main 08d75f4):

1. Consent ordering and externally visible variants
- Invalid request-schema input still returns the existing 400 before handler execution.
- A missing session, including a wrong-profile session hidden by the scoped repository, returns the existing 404 even when LLM consent is withdrawn; no LLM dispatch occurs.
- An existing topic-scoped session that would reach evaluateQuickCheckAnswer returns the existing consent-denied 403 when consent is withdrawn, before any LLM dispatch.
- An existing session without a topic uses the same consent boundary and returns 403 on withdrawal before its general quick-check dispatch.
- With active consent, each existing-session path still dispatches exactly once and preserves the existing topic-context lookup and response semantics.

2. Boundary coverage
- Update apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.manifest.ts and apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts so the final quick-check consent owner and ordering are structurally represented; the guard must fail if this LLM path becomes unclassified or can dispatch without a consent boundary. Quick-check metering remains route-owned and unchanged.

3. Regression proof
- Add focused regression cases in apps/api/src/routes/assessments.test.ts for withdrawn-consent missing-session 404, withdrawn-consent wrong-profile 404, withdrawn-consent existing topic/no-topic 403 with no dispatch, and active-consent dispatch. The regression test must fail against the production implementation with the fix reverted and pass with the fix present.
- Execute and record the focused red -> green -> production-revert red -> exact-restore green sequence with: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/mentomate_test pnpm exec jest --config apps/api/jest.config.cjs --runInBand --silent apps/api/src/routes/assessments.test.ts apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts
- Run routed validation with: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/mentomate_test bash scripts/check-change-class.sh --run --fast

4. Scope and authority
- Expected collision set: apps/api/src/routes/assessments.ts, apps/api/src/routes/assessments.test.ts, apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.manifest.ts, and apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts; touch assessment service/test files only if the selected boundary placement requires them.
- Preserve scoped-repository ownership hiding, session/topic lookup semantics, response schema, prompt/model/provider routing, and metering. No schema, migration, session policy, or unrelated consent-policy change is authorized. If one becomes necessary, stop and obtain a separate ruling/item.
- Acceptance requires an exact-head strict-green Adversarial review because this is a P1 consent/security boundary change.
riskImpact: P1 privacy/control-order defect at a scoped quick-check LLM boundary. Incorrect placement can either dispatch after withdrawal or reveal/change scoped session-not-found behavior. The repair is bounded to one route flow plus structural coverage; no schema or session-policy change is required.
